function: RecipeBuilder (Create, Category, Level, SkillUpToRank, Quantity, Resref, EffectDescription, EnhancementSlots, ResearchCostModifier, Inactive, Requirement*, Component, Build)
description: What the recipe builder produces for a call sequence: the defaults of a new recipe, a quantity below 1 becoming 1, a practice rank limit below 1 being rejected, a repeated component or enhancement slot call replacing the earlier one, effect lines adding up, and a recipe type created twice being rejected.
inputs: Hand-written call sequences, one per row; the result lists skill, category, level, practice rank limit, quantity, resref, active flag, enhancement type and slots, research cost modifier, components, requirements and effect lines of each recipe built, or the exception.
rows: components in order, repeated one replaced
